ideas.pitch: A high-performance full-text search engine extension optimized for Bun and Next.js applications, built to solve slow client-side filtering in open-source boilerplate projects.
ideas.title: Bun-Native SQLite FTS5 Extension for Next.js
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting open-source contributions to popular ecosystems like Bun and Next.js maximizes real-world impact and technical complexity scores, aligning with the evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: An open-source diagnostic extension for VS Code written in Rust via WebAssembly to detect memory leaks in heavy IDE plugins in real time.
ideas.title: Rust-Powered Memory Profiler for VS Code Extensions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high technical complexity with real-world developer impact, hitting the two highest-weighted judging rubrics for code quality and reliability.

ideas.pitch: An AST-based open-source CLI utility that scans React and Next.js codebases to safely prune unused Tailwind utility classes and custom design tokens.
ideas.title: Tailwind CSS Component Dead-Code Eliminator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a widespread developer pain point in modern web development with a clean, high-impact pull request that is easy for open-source maintainers to review and merge.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight eBPF-based metrics exporter for Linux systems that feeds kernel-level block I/O latency directly into Prometheus without user-space overhead.
ideas.title: Linux Kernel BPF Tracepoint Exporter for Prometheus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates extreme technical complexity and systems-level engineering, guaranteeing maximum points under technical complexity and testing/reliability.

ideas.pitch: An automated GitHub Action powered by local embeddings that checks incoming pull requests against repository-specific contribution guidelines and code style rules.
ideas.title: Semantic PR Reviewer Bot for Open Source Repositories
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate real-world value to open-source maintainers struggling with PR quality, scoring high on real-world impact and design.
